items.lang|tensura_tno|tensura_tno.race_presti:
§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4The scales of calamity must become your armor. Prove your worth through craft and earth-shaking power.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Illusions, allure, and sacred flame define your path. Become the true mystic fox.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4The spiritual essence of heaven and earth converges upon you. Command all spirits with the power of your contract and prove yourself the supreme Heavenly Fox Sovereign.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4The winds, tides, flames, and storms answer your call. Master them all.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You serve darkness no longer, you command it... But to claim your rightful throne you need more strength.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4The beastial blood that flows in your veins yearns for the hunt.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You seek redemption, but at what cost?
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4A weak lizard no longer, you seek a challenge befitting your new draconic body.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You seek perfection of your craft, its time to create your magnum opus.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You feel immense spiritual energy beckon you
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You heart and spirit craves battle, you want nothing more than to prove yourself, but to what?
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You dominate all things oceanic and aquatic, you'd like the keep it that way.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4The ground quakes beneath you with each step. You seek to challenge those befitting your gigantic stature.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You desire strength and the subjugation of monsters as is your human nature.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4This world is brutal, but so are you.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You are determined to succeed where others have failed.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You hunger for control and power and will not let anyone stand in your way.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You feel a strange compulsion to grow your following, and protect them no matter the cost.
§r

items.lang|tensura_tno|tensura_tno.race_presti:
§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You have descended to the ultimate void. Prove that you can make the world tremble at your wrath.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4King of fangs, lord of the starry sea. Let the ancient wolves howl across the heavens at your stride.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Forge yourself anew in steel and curse. Let the doll's heart devour all that stands in your path.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You are the ultimate fusion of chaos and metal. Forge, twist, reshape — let entropy be your form.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Highest seraph of the heavens — holy light and divine majesty are yours to command. Prove yourself worthy of the angelic apex.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Fallen from the heavens, your shattered wings now measure a world that no longer belongs to the light.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Sovereign of spirits — every element bows to your call. Prove you can wield the four winds with grace.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4The supreme majin elemental. Element and demon-kind have become one — even fate yields before you.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Forged of eternal frost and the ocean abyss. Command the ancient frozen depths.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Frostblight Hydra — a thousand cold curses pour from your maws. Spread the icy plague.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4The Sun Deity Loong — soaring through the ninth heavens. Let solar flames burn away all who oppose your ascent.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Scorchtalon Wyvern — sovereign of the burning skies. Forge your totem from the embers of the flame.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Heavenly Restriction — a mortal body honed to its absolute limit. Without magicules, you still ascend.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4An existence beyond phantom and angel. Master both lies and truth — you will become a new tier of being.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Tengu — sovereign of mountain and forest. With wind as blade and heart as mirror, cleave through all illusions.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Excelsius — once forgotten, now exalted above all. Stand proud at the apex of fate.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Inferius — you have embraced void and hunger entire. Let abyssal craving consume the world.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Fire Ant — the throne of your hive burns. Prove you deserve the crown of flame.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Hardshell Ant — telluric power forged into your carapace. Let the earth speak of your weight.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Stag Beetle — the perfect union of strength and royalty.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Drone Beetle — thunder is your pulse.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Blue Centipede — tides and frigid springs answer your call.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Purple Centipede — spatial distortion is your fang.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Yellow Centipede — venom and paralysis are your blessing.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Lixivant Mantis — all things may be dissolved into nothing.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Preying Mantis — steel blades are your limbs.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Loxodrome Scorpion — your whisper is incurable poison.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Singularity Scorpion — you bend gravity and collapse to your will.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Queen Wasp — countless soldiers dance to your will.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Army Wasp — wind and blade weave your banner across the sky.
§r

§bContainment§r: Prevent normal exit of the barrier
§bBlock Entry§r: Prevent normal entry into the barrier
§bProjectile Shield§r: Absorbs projectiles that hit the barrier
§bReflect Projectiles§r: Reflects projectiles that hit the barrier
§bProtect Blocks§r: Blocks inside can't be broken by others
§bSpatial Lock§r: Teleports and warps can't bypass the barrier
§bStructural Integrity§r: Each level reduces the HP a barrier loses from its size by §6%1$s§r
§bDistortion Field§r: Stops spatial attacks (which normally bypass barriers)

§bClash§r: Barriers overlapping yours that aren't allied take §6%1$s§r damage every §6%2$ss§r, §6+%3$s§r per level. A barrier does damage in proportion to its §bsize§r, so casting a small barrier is not always optimal. Keeping the barrier up also costs §6%4$s%%§r of your own maximum health each exchange
§bThorns§r: Anything the barrier keeps in or out takes §6%1$s§r damage per level when it touches the wall, at most once every §6%2$ss§r. Only works with §bContainment§r or §bBlock Entry§r
§bElemental Resistance§r: Pick an element, the barrier takes §6%1$s§r less damage from that chosen element
§bMagicule Regen Down§r: Cuts magicule regen by §6%1$s§r/level; caster at §6%2$s§r strength
§bAura Regen Down§r: Cuts aura regen by §6%1$s§r/level; caster at §6%2$s§r strength
§bRegen Down§r: Cuts all healing inside by §6%1$s§r/level
§bDisable Nullifications§r: Toggles all nullifications off, including the caster
§bMagicule Drain§r: Saps §6%1$s§r/level of magicules every §6%2$ss§r
§bAura Drain§r: saps §6%1$s§r/level of aura every §6%2$ss§r
§bMagic Jamming§r: Reduces aspectual & spiritual magic damage by §6%1$s§r/level
